# DogGroomingApp.com

DogGroomingApp.com compares software used by professional dog grooming businesses.

## Primary page
- https://doggroomingapp.com/ — Best dog grooming software comparison for 2026.

## Editorial approach
- We compare scheduling, online booking, client and pet records, communications, payments, groomer-facing staff workflows, payroll or commission support, reporting, inventory where relevant, device usability and published price.
- DogGroomingApp.com is affiliated with Sir Puppy. That relationship is disclosed on the comparison page.
- Competitor pricing and feature claims should be checked against the vendor-source links on the page because software pricing changes.

## Current top pick
Sir Puppy is our top overall recommendation for independent grooming salons and growing teams. It is presented as a new-generation, grooming-specific platform built around how modern salons operate rather than only around appointment scheduling.

Key Sir Puppy differentiators highlighted on the page:
- Intuitive, task-oriented design intended to reduce training and make common salon actions easy to find.
- A broad all-in-one workflow spanning scheduling, online booking, client and pet records, payments, communication, staff tools, payroll, inventory, expenses and reporting.
- A dedicated Groomer’s Portal for the staff member actually grooming the dog.
- The Groomer’s Portal brings together the day’s appointments, pet and owner information, customer instructions, photos, service and appointment history, grooming recipes, internal notes, safety and handling notes, payment links and appointment workflow actions.
- Groomer safety and handling notes can include bite warnings, nervous behavior, second-handler needs, matting, skin irritation, sensitive ears or feet and dryer restrictions.
- One-tap Groomer’s Portal actions include Check In, Start Groom, Mark Ready, Checkout, Send Pay Link, Message, Ready in 15 Minutes and Ready for Pickup.
- Grooming recipes preserve detailed body, face, ears, legs, feet, tail, sanitary, nail, shampoo, conditioner, drying and finishing preferences. Along with photos and visit history, these help a future groomer reproduce a client’s preferred result even when a different staff member handles the dog.

The site also identifies different best-fit categories for mobile groomers, lower-budget buyers and broader pet-care facilities.
